    input = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    index = 0
    T = int(input[index])
    index += 1
    results = []
    for _ in range(T):
        N = int(input[index])
        index += 1
        if N == 1:
            results.append("1")
        elif N == 2:
            results.append("2 1")
        else:
            base = "1 2 3 2 1 2 3"
            if N <= 7:
                results.append(base.split()[0:N])
            else:
                repeat_count = (N - 7) // 3
                remainder = (N - 7) % 3
                results.append((base + " 2 3 2" * repeat_count + " " + " ".join(base.split()[0:remainder])).strip())
    print("\n".join(" ".join(map(str, result)) for result in results))
